title: Yoisaki Kanade — Wishing Her A Restful Night〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello.
Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is Asahina not back yet...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, she said she has club today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but she did say that it's okay for you to clean like you normally do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll get started like normal.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of cleaning, would it be alright if I sorted the cabinet with all the tea?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's starting to get pretty full.
To be fair, it's my fault for bringing over so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, there is a lot in here now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Understood.
I'll do my best to make things easy to find.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The lyrics Mafuyu wrote are very good. I should make sure the music is more reflective of...)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Dinner's just about ready, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, okay. I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu...
I didn't realize you were back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here you are, Ms. Yoisaki.
I made teriyaki tofu steaks today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mmm... This is good.
And it's not too rich. I really like it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you're enjoying it so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
I've also finished sorting out the tea cabinet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
These tins were so cluttered. Now they're completely organized.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I initially began by transferring the tea leaves that were running low into their own zipper bags.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I placed the ones that should be used first in the front and the unopened tins a little towards the back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The ones further back are in a case with a handle on it, so they should be easy to retrieve. Please let me know if you have any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I saw this lavender-flavored tea that I didn't recognize. Did you and Asahina buy it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's the tea my dad brought over.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's so nice of him. Then, I'm glad I decided to put it towards the front since it seemed special and like it had just been opened.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. We really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I'm amazed by how you could tell that it was special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. As I just mentioned, I didn't recognize it, and it's from a famous shop.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Does your dad know quite a lot about teas, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
He likes to drink tea...
But I don't think he knows much about who makes what.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, he may've done a bit of research before actually going over to this shop.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's supposed to be quite soothing, so I hope you get a chance to drink it during breaks and such.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (He looked at Mafuyu so tenderly that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki may be right. He probably put a lot of thought into that tea. For his daughter's sake.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
We should try to savor every drop of that tea.
